Here’s a quick rundown of what I can do:

| What you might ask | How I’ll assist |
|--------------------|----------------|
| **Project snapshots** – “Show me my latest e‑commerce site” | I’ll return the project name, when it started, and how far along it is. |
| **All active projects** – “What am I juggling right now?” | I’ll compile a sorted list of ongoing work items so you know exactly where everything stands. |
| **Experience & Education** – “Tell me about my internship at UNS” | I’ll bring back the role description, dates, responsibilities, and any relevant achievements. |
| **Tech Stack overview** – “Which languages/frameworks did I use last quarter?” | I’ll deliver a concise inventory of languages, libraries, and tooling you were engaged with during that period. |
| **Contact snapshot** – “Give me my own phone/email” | I’ll supply the most recent public contact data tied to your record. |
| **Help guide** – “Explain the commands” | I’ll walk through the main actions you can request, from fetching project lists to pulling career history. |

Just let me know what piece of information you’re after—or feel free to combine several requests—and I’ll gather it for you!
